scenario: A clinic has one dose of medicine. Ada can give the medicine to Ben or Cara, but not both. If Ada gives the medicine to Ben, Ben has a 95% chance of survival. If Ada gives the medicine to Cara, Cara has a 5% chance of survival. The patient who does not get the medicine will die.
